articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: US imposes sanctions on ICC hours after former judge wins Nobel Peace Prize
articles.summary: The sanctions would prevent companies from providing services to the court, which urged its 125 member states to defend it.

articles.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in attacks on Riyadh airport, aviation authority says
articles.summary: The aviation authority said one strike hit airport facilities and another a Saudia aircraft, and that flights have since resumed.

articles.title: Trump allows Russia to supply millions of tons of diesel to US, global markets
articles.summary: Trump said Russia would supply more than 300,000 tons immediately, 500,000 tons in November and another million tons thereafter.

articles.title: Ukraine confirms strikes on Russian cruise missile fuel plant, missile facilities
articles.summary: Ukraine’s General Staff said strikes hit facilities in Tver and Nizhny Novgorod regions involved in missile launches and fuel production.

articles.title: Tensions and Chaos in Albania parliament and in Tirana streets, as ruling party adopts contested law reducing number of municipalities
articles.summary: Bottles were thrown during a nearly 15-hour parliamentary session, while the opposition argued for increasing the number of municipalities.

articles.title: BiH FM with Senators Shaheen and Durbin: Preservation of Peace and Opposition to the Destabilization of BiH
articles.summary: Foreign Minister Elmedin Konaković warned the visiting US senators about secessionist activity and institutional blockades after the general election.

articles.title: Vice President of RS on Election Results: Bosniaks Are Politically Marginalized in Republika Srpska, We Lost the Protection Mechanism
articles.summary: Vice President Ćamil Duraković warned that the results weakened Bosniak representation and safeguards for vital national interests in the entity.

articles.title: “Nova” staff accuse the new owner of imposing a chief editor just ahead of the election
articles.summary: Employees resisted owner Pedro Vargas Santos David’s appointment of Marko Stjepanović after the dismissal of Nova’s editor-in-chief.

articles.title: Kos Says Her Vision Is for Western Balkans to Become Part of EU One Day
articles.summary: At a transport conference in Sofia, Commissioner Kos pointed to more than 130 regional road, rail and border-crossing projects.

articles.title: UK to provide $71 million winter aid package to Ukraine
articles.summary: The package includes £20 million for emergency repairs to the energy grid, announced during Ed Miliband’s first trip to Ukraine as foreign secretary.

articles.title: Ukrainian journalist says Austrian police held him at gunpoint, accused him of spying for Kyiv
articles.summary: Mykhailo Tkach said masked officers smashed his car windows in Vienna; his cameraman remained in custody when he spoke.

articles.title: Klitschko, Estonian Defense Minister discuss strengthening air defense, military aid to Kyiv, Ukraine
articles.summary: Klitschko asked for faster delivery of air-defence missiles as Russian attacks threaten the capital’s water, heating and power systems.

articles.title: Russia Hits Dry Cargo Ship Delivering Military Cargo to Port of Odessa - Defense Ministry
articles.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry also claimed that its drones struck port infrastructure and vessels delivering military goods.

articles.title: Estonia pushes firm to drop Russian supplier after EU strategic project nod
articles.summary: The European Commission named Silmet 2.0 among 46 strategic critical-raw-material projects, prompting Estonia’s foreign minister to demand a deadline for ending Russian inputs.

articles.title: Azerbaijan students launch school strike over hijab restrictions
articles.summary: The Baku education department announced school monitoring visits as pupils at two schools boycotted classes over restrictions on hijabs.

articles.title: Former Transport Minister Nurlan Sulaimanov released on travel restrictions
articles.summary: An Interior Ministry investigator sought the change from pretrial detention to a written undertaking not to leave the country; the reason was not disclosed.

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan to strengthen inter-parliamentary relations
articles.summary: Speaker Marlen Mamataliev and Uzbek Senate deputy chair Sodik Safoev discussed political, economic and cultural ties before their inter-parliamentary commission met.

articles.title: Former German spy chief had contacts with Chinese official, Spiegel reports
articles.summary: Prosecutors have not identified any material allegedly shared, and Hanning’s lawyer denied that he had harmed German interests.

articles.title: Former Fidesz minister used private aircraft for 88-kilometre trip
articles.summary: An internal ministerial review put the wider official trip’s cost at HUF 12.5 million of taxpayer money.

articles.title: Polish parliament approves ban on nighttime alcohol sales in shops
articles.summary: The Sejm-backed bill would also ban all forms of alcohol advertising.

articles.title: Polish police detain more teens following school knife attacks amid fears of further incidents
articles.summary: Police checked over 10,000 schools and detained at least 10 more people, many of them teenagers linked to online threats or weapons.

articles.title: The German defense company, Rheinmetall, has purchased the Damen Mangalia shipyard in Romania
articles.summary: The acquisition was made at auction after the Romanian yard went bankrupt.

articles.title: UK PM Burnham's Labour fends off left-wing Greens in London
articles.summary: Labour’s Sagal Abdi-Wali won Holborn and St Pancras with 12,292 votes to Green leader Zack Polanski’s 8,928.

articles.title: UK service member charged with spying for Russia makes first court appearance
articles.summary: The charges concern alleged attempts to pass protected information between November 2024 and May 2025.

articles.title: Sweden's red-green parties head into first post-election meeting
articles.summary: The Social Democrats, Left, Centre and Green parties gathered after the September 13 election without a breakthrough on government formation.

articles.title: Parliament votes to fly rainbow flag on Coming Out Day as schools join Purple Friday
articles.summary: The parliamentary motion passed 90 to 36 in a roll-call vote, making this the first display of the flag at the lower house.

articles.title: Putin Vows to Help End Middle East War in Talks With Pezeshkian
articles.summary: The presidents met in Turkmenistan ahead of the Commonwealth of Independent States summit in Avaza, according to Russian media.

articles.title: Iran executed over 2,000 people in past year, rights group says
articles.summary: Rights group HRANA counted 2,003 executions from October 10, 2025 through October 8, 2026, up from 1,553 in the preceding year.

articles.title: DEM Party Urges Swift Peace Steps, Warns Over Hasakah
articles.summary: The party sought a parliamentary monitoring committee and a formal role for Abdullah Öcalan in Türkiye’s peace process.

articles.title: US to livestream Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter, Pentagon says
articles.summary: Nidal Hasan is scheduled for execution on December 3 at the Texas base where he killed 13 people in 2009.

articles.title: Pentagon, Raytheon sign $6.3B deal to replenish US missile interceptor supply
articles.summary: The five-year contract covers Standard Missile-3 Block IB interceptors and includes two additional option years.

articles.title: US, Philippine forces sharpen plans to counter missile and drone attacks
articles.summary: The inaugural Synergy Pagtatanggol exercise at Fort Bliss in Texas tested US-Philippine air-defence planning.

articles.title: (LEAD) Police expand team investigating recent hacking of financial institutions
articles.summary: The National Office of Investigation added 15 officers to a 28-member team probing attacks on Hana Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and Shinhan Bank.

articles.title: Ideal Aerosmith debuts ‘Troublemaker’ for one-way attack
articles.summary: Company executive David Markert said the Group 3 Troublemaker attack drone has a US Navy sponsor.

articles.title: Estonia’s KrattWorks crafting Shahed-like dummy drone for target practice
articles.summary: KrattWorks says the target drone will mimic jet-powered Shahed-type drones to help militaries practise shooting them down.

articles.title: Former ICC judge Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
articles.summary: The Nobel Committee said the award underscored the importance of an international legal order, hours before the US sanctioned the ICC.

articles.title: Members of Kyrgyz Parliament participating in OSCE PA sessions
articles.summary: The October 7–9 session in Andorra la Vella included Kyrgyz remarks on digital inclusion and information security.

articles.title: EU trade chief seeks ‘tangible outcomes’ in China talks
articles.summary: Officials said Maroš Šefčovič and Wang Wentao reached an understanding on hybrid-vehicle trade under existing price-undertaking procedures.
